programs.title: Love Nature
programs.desc: The opportunity to see a totally black sky unaffected by light pollution is rare. But lack of such pollution means stars can be seen more clearly at Northumberland National Park.

programs.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programs.desc: Susan explores the Borders, east coast and Edinburgh, visiting iconic aircraft Concorde, historic Musselburgh, and more. She also hears of the real-life inspiration for Sherlock Holmes.

programs.title: Police Interceptors
programs.desc: A suspected drink driver tries to ram interceptors off the road. And the drone and dog teams pursue a suspected drink driver after he hits Tarnia in the face and legs it.

programs.title: Traffic Cops
programs.desc: Police hunt a man wanted on suspicion of stalking, but the operation spirals into a standoff. And officers head to remote woodland, where a wanted man is believed to be in hiding.

programs.title: The Ex-Wife
programs.desc: Three years after the events of the first series Tasha and Emily are living in Cyprus under fake names. While Jen plans her wedding, Tasha finds out about Jack's early prison release.

programs.title: Bradley Walsh: All My Best Bits
programs.desc: In a personal and hilarious account, featuring contributions from pals and peers, Bradley recounts his life from struggling comic to success as an actor and game show host.
